subtitle: k-means forces you to pick k. Nothing in the data announces the answer.

eyebrow: Why inertia can never choose k alone

steps.label: MORE CENTROIDS = EVERY ROW CLOSER
steps.sub: Falls to 0 when k = number of rows

code:
for k in range(2, 9):
    m = KMeans(n_clusters=k, n_init=10).fit(Xs)

caption: 2->3: huge drop (304.6 to 52.4). 3->4: only ~10. Diminishing returns start right at 3.

steps.label: A SHARP BEND AT k=3
steps.sub: Real data often gives a gentler, debatable elbow

eyebrow: The silhouette score: a direct peak
caption: Unlike inertia, silhouette can go DOWN as k rises -- it can name a maximum directly.
Real output: elbow AND silhouette peak both land on k=3 -- matching the true 3 groups.
